infoLinks.urlText: Meadowbank Station Lift 2 between the footbridge and Platform 2 or Bank St is not available
infoLinks.content:
At Meadowbank Station Lift 2 between the footbridge and Platform 2 or Bank St is temporarily out of service.
From Monday 9 until Sunday 15 November, the lift that services between the station footbridge, Platform 2 and Bank Street will be closed for lift maintenance. Lift access to the station will be available on the opposite side on Railway Road. The ramp between Bank Street and Platform 2 will be available to enter and exit the station.

If you need lift access to Platform 2 or Bank Street from the concourse, catch a train from Platform 1 and change at Rhodes Station to return via Platform 2.

Customers on Bank Street or Platform 2 that need lift access to the concourse will need to catch a train from Platform 2 and change at Eastwood Station to return via Platform 1.

If you need further assistance, ask station staff or call 02 9752 8460.
